about: Code Violet:  Survive the Horror, Unravel the Truth Dive into Code Violet, an exhilarating third-person action horror game from TeamKill Media.
In the 25th century, a cataclysm has left Earth uninhabitable, driving humanity’s survivors to Trappist 1-E.
Facing extinction due to sterility, the Aion colony harnesses cutting-edge time-travel technology to abduct women from the past to be surrogates in a dark yet desperate bid to save mankind.

But their mission conceals a sinister conspiracy. As Violet Sinclair, torn from your time, you awaken in the Aion Bioengineering Complex, swarming with ferocious prehistoric dinosaurs and hostile forces.
Carefully manage your inventory, uncover Aion’s dark secrets, fight to survive, and escape during a chaotic evacuation protocol.
Can you save those you care for and make it out alive?
